profile.name: Suhani Mehra
profile.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer & Data Analyst
profile.bio: I build scalable web platforms, real-time computer vision systems, and analytical dashboards using React, Python, and modern cloud technologies.
profile.shortBio: A self-driven Computer Science engineer combining strong algorithmic foundations with modern web interfaces and data analytics.

philosophy.heading: Turning complex problems into clean, maintainable systems.
philosophy.paragraph1: From developing computer vision systems with real-time facial recognition to creating accessible travel booking platforms and enterprise-grade data dashboards, my focus is practical engineering impact.
philosophy.paragraph2: I prioritize clean architecture, performant user interactions, and robust layouts that look exceptional across every screen size.
